$comment: Custom models for the 3D world (docs/custom-models.md). Every slot is listed. null means the code-built shape is used, so an empty slot never requests a file. To use a model: export it as <slot>.glb into this folder, replace null with { "file": "spire.glb", "author": "Your Name", "source": "team-made", "version": 1 }, add a line to CREDITS.md, then run pnpm models:check.
